title: Test output-size route/frame slot attribution and successful journal drains deterministically
outcome: Telemetry tests verify route/frame-to-slot attribution and successful bounded journal output with isolated observer state and no dependence on global test order.
acceptance: Deterministic tests exercise finite HTTP band crossings/completion, per-frame SSE observation, and fixed route-to-producer mapping against isolated observer state.
A successful journal drain is tested, including bounded fixed records and no payload logging; parallel tests do not drain one another's observations.
